extracted.intended_audience: individual investors in Vanguard mutual funds and ETFs; shareholders interested in proxy voting
extracted.subtask_description: Explains how Vanguard funds approach and administer proxy voting and describes the Investor Choice program that lets certain individual investors express views on shareholder matters in the funds' holdings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proxy voting administered in accordance with stated voting policies
rubrics_metrics.description: The managers administer proxy voting in accordance with the stated voting policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Across Vanguard’s more than 400 funds worldwide, some two dozen internal and external investment managers cast proxy votes on behalf of the respective funds—or portion of funds—that they manage. Each manager follows its stated voting policies when casting votes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proxy votes cast in pursuit of each fund’s stated investment objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Managers cast proxy votes in pursuit of each fund’s stated investment objective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proxy voting decisions are intended to align with the investment objectives of the particular fund whose shares are being voted. Investors should consider a fund’s stated objective to understand the rationale behind its voting behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Choice program allows eligible investors to express perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Vanguard's Investor Choice program enables individual investors in certain equity index funds to express their perspectives on shareholder matters at the companies held in their funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investor Choice is available to investors in certain Vanguard-advised mutual funds and ETFs and provides the opportunity for more direct participation in the proxy voting process. Eligibility is limited to certain equity index funds—investors should check whether their fund participates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Different managers have distinct policies and approaches to proxy voting
rubrics_metrics.description: Vanguard offers more than 400 funds that are managed by over two dozen highly respected investment managers, each with their own policies and approaches to proxy voting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because multiple internal and external managers oversee voting across Vanguard funds, proxy voting practices can vary by fund and manager; investors who want specifics should review the voting policies for the particular fund or manager.
